summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting that at its June 11, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, shareholders approved an amendment allowing up to twelve one-month extensions of its initial business combination deadline through June 20, 2027, with each extension requiring a sponsor deposit of the lesser of $60,000 or $0.033 per outstanding IPO share. Holders of 1,507,257 shares exercised redemption rights. On June 18, 2026, sponsor Whale Management Corp deposited the first $51,482 extension payment, extending the deadline from June 20 to July 20, 2026. Watch for future monthly extension payments and the risk of failure to consummate a de-SPAC transaction.
